// @version=5
indicator("Lucid 2 — VWAP Band (0.20%, SL 25 / TP 100)", overlay=true, max_labels_count=500, max_lines_count=50)

// =========================================================================
// VWAP band break, both directions — USE A 5-MINUTE CHART
// Entry : 5-min close breaks out of the RTH VWAP +/- 0.20% band (previous
//         close inside, this close outside); not Wednesday; first trade only
// SL    : 25 pt from entry (filled at the worse of stop and bar open)
// TP    : 100 pt from entry
// Exit  : SL/TP hit OR the 15:55 bar's close. One trade a day.
//
// Changed 2026-10-23: the old version traded a plain VWAP cross, which is not
// what the book was tested on. Measured on NQ 2018-2025 with costs and the
// vol gate: plain cross +2.3 / +0.7 pt per trade (2018-21 / 2022-25), this
// band break +3.6 / +3.0 pt (live_spec_exporter, score_live_spec.py).
// =========================================================================

showHist = input.bool(true, "Show historical entries/exits")
bandPct  = input.float(0.20, "Band around VWAP (%)") / 100.0
slPts    = input.float(25.0, "Stop-loss (pt)")
tpPts    = input.float(100.0, "Take-profit (pt)")
volCeil  = input.float(0.30, "Max 20d realised vol (skip day above this)")

// See lucid_1 for why this gate exists: point-denominated stops risk far more
// dollars per trade in a high-volatility regime, and the trailing drawdown
// arrives correspondingly sooner.
// Daily values: last COMPLETED session ([1] + lookahead_on), identical in history and
// real time (lookahead_off would use the forming daily bar live). Fixed 2026-10-23.
rvol20 = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", (ta.stdev(close / close[1] - 1.0, 20) * math.sqrt(252))[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
volOK = na(rvol20) or rvol20 < volCeil

// Session + DOW
hET = hour(time, "America/New_York")
mET = minute(time, "America/New_York")
etMin = hET * 60 + mET
dowET = dayofweek(time, "America/New_York")
isWed = dowET == dayofweek.wednesday
rthFlag = not na(time(timeframe.period, "0930-1600", "America/New_York"))

// RTH VWAP anchored
rthStart = rthFlag and not nz(rthFlag[1], false)
vwapVal = ta.vwap(hlc3, rthStart)

// Band-break signals (previous bar inside the band, this close outside)
upB = vwapVal * (1.0 + bandPct)
loB = vwapVal * (1.0 - bandPct)
prevRth = nz(rthFlag[1], false) and not rthStart
xUp = rthFlag and prevRth and close > upB and close[1] <= upB[1]
xDn = rthFlag and prevRth and close < loB and close[1] >= loB[1]
is5 = timeframe.period == "5"

// Trade state
var float vEntry = na
var float vSL    = na
var float vTP    = na
var int   vDir   = na
var int   vBar   = na
var int   vDayId = na
var bool  vDone  = false
curDayId = year*10000 + month*100 + dayofmonth
dayChg = ta.change(curDayId) != 0
if dayChg
    vDone := false

canTrade = is5 and not isWed and volOK and rthFlag and etMin < 15*60+50 and na(vEntry) and not vDone and barstate.isconfirmed

if canTrade and xUp
    vEntry := close
    vDir   := 1
    vSL    := close - slPts
    vTP    := close + tpPts
    vBar   := bar_index
    vDayId := curDayId
if canTrade and xDn
    vEntry := close
    vDir   := -1
    vSL    := close + slPts
    vTP    := close - tpPts
    vBar   := bar_index
    vDayId := curDayId

// Exit management
isEOD = etMin >= 15*60+55
if not na(vEntry) and bar_index > vBar      // stop/target work from the bar after entry
    exReason = ""
    exPx = 0.0
    if vDir == 1
        if low <= vSL
            exReason := "SL"
            exPx := math.min(vSL, open)
        else if high >= vTP
            exReason := "TP"
            exPx := vTP
        else if isEOD or dayChg
            exReason := "EOD"
            exPx := close
    else
        if high >= vSL
            exReason := "SL"
            exPx := math.max(vSL, open)
        else if low <= vTP
            exReason := "TP"
            exPx := vTP
        else if isEOD or dayChg
            exReason := "EOD"
            exPx := close
    if exReason != ""
        pnl = vDir * (exPx - vEntry)
        if showHist
            label.new(bar_index, exPx, "VWAP " + exReason + "\n" + str.tostring(pnl, "+#.#") + "pt", color=pnl >= 0 ? color.new(color.green, 20) : color.new(color.red, 20), textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.tiny)
        vEntry := na
        vSL := na
        vTP := na
        vDir := na
        vDone := true

// Entry markers (historical)
plotshape(showHist and xUp and not isWed, "VWAP long", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, color=color.aqua, size=size.small, text="VL")
plotshape(showHist and xDn and not isWed, "VWAP short", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, color=color.fuchsia, size=size.small, text="VS")

// Live lines
var line veLn = na
var line vslLn = na
var line vtpLn = na
if barstate.islast
    if not na(veLn)
        line.delete(veLn)
    if not na(vslLn)
        line.delete(vslLn)
    if not na(vtpLn)
        line.delete(vtpLn)
    if not na(vEntry) and vDayId == curDayId
        clrDir = vDir == 1 ? color.aqua : color.fuchsia
        veLn := line.new(vBar, vEntry, bar_index + 20, vEntry, color=clrDir, width=2, extend=extend.right)
        vslLn := line.new(vBar, vSL, bar_index + 20, vSL, color=color.new(color.red, 20), style=line.style_dashed, extend=extend.right)
        vtpLn := line.new(vBar, vTP, bar_index + 20, vTP, color=color.new(color.green, 20), style=line.style_dashed, extend=extend.right)

// Reference plots
plot(rthFlag ? vwapVal : na, "VWAP (RTH)", color=color.new(color.yellow, 20), linewidth=2)
plot(rthFlag ? upB : na, "upper band", color=color.new(color.aqua, 40))
plot(rthFlag ? loB : na, "lower band", color=color.new(color.fuchsia, 40))

// Mini status badge
var table badgeV = table.new(position.top_right, 1, 3, border_width=1, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30))
if barstate.islast
    sessStateV = etMin < 570 ? "PRE-OPEN" : etMin < 955 ? "LIVE (watch cross)" : "CLOSE SOON"
    sessColV = etMin >= 570 and etMin < 955 ? color.new(color.aqua, 30) : color.new(color.gray, 50)
    table.cell(badgeV, 0, 0, is5 ? "VWAP BAND" : "VWAP BAND: use a 5-minute chart", bgcolor=is5 ? color.new(color.yellow, 50) : color.red, text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(badgeV, 0, 1, isWed ? "WED — SKIP" : vDone ? "DONE TODAY" : sessStateV, bgcolor=isWed ? color.red : vDone ? color.new(color.gray, 30) : sessColV, text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(badgeV, 0, 2, not na(vEntry) ? "LIVE " + (vDir==1?"L ":"S ") + str.tostring(vEntry, format.mintick) : "no position", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 50))
